mistake: 80 Kling credits charged for a job whose ID was lost; ledger carries an unresolved row
root_cause: job ID not persisted immediately after submission
solution: persist returned job ID and charge before any other action; query the task list by CLI to recover or mark unrecoverable
rule_added: W38 'persist immediately'; .claude/hooks/no-retry.py; lint advisory on unreconciled rows

mistake: Two image jobs charged 41 credits each against an expected ~20; 70 vs 30 on identical 5 s videos
cost: two 41-credit image charges and a 70-versus-30 video delta, not reconciled (no total asserted)
root_cause: pricing inferred from documentation, not read from the live schema per job
solution: record model, resolution and option flags per job; compare each charge to the documented rate and flag deltas
rule_added: scope.json requires modelInputSlots and ceiling; ledger notes carry the option set

mistake: Phase A request.json passed 5 images to gemini-3-pro-image, which declares image_1/image_2 only
root_cause: request assembled from a plan rather than from the live who_am_i schema
solution: request-r2 with 2 inputs; every request validated against the declared slot count before submit

mistake: Galileo preview v1 places the resolution reaction (21.5-25.5 s) before the line that motivates it, G-L04 (25.5-33.5 s)
root_cause: reaction cut from eye references without checking the audio timing of the causing line
solution: a reaction never precedes its cause; timeline v2 re-ordered against measured dialogue
rule_added: W41 sync review row; direction doc section 5

mistake: Listening pilots show a different table and seat than the speech clips (F01)
cost: pilot takes not reusable as shared-space evidence
root_cause: pilot shots generated without a locked table geometry and axis packet
solution: over-the-shoulder reference packet with D04 table and D09 axis before any new motion; D17 geometry recorded only after an accepted test shot
rule_added: W35 reference packet gate; chapter checklist row 'Safe motion/axis/reference packet'

mistake: Scene bibles v1 section 3 still carry dialogue superseded by script v2 (F05); continuity matrix has stale-stage lines (F06)
cost: risk of generating against old lines
root_cause: bible revisions appended as proposals without one integrated revision per chapter
solution: one revision per bible citing D07 and D20; matrix v2

mistake: D16 (23-credit Phase A test) recorded as relayed via a bot rather than confirmed by Andre directly
root_cause: approval provenance not checked against the Andre-only gate list
solution: Andre confirms or supersedes directly; decision record updated with grantedBy and quote; relayed grants never pass preflight

mistake: First Parley round delivered research and documents but not the new images; the principal creative delivery was not kept explicit
detected_by: REPEATABLE_WORKFLOW lessons of the first Parley round
cost: one round without the deliverable the film needed
root_cause: assignments did not name the one creative deliverable, what blocked it and who owned the blocker
solution: every dispatch names the deliverable, the blocker that stops it and the owner; successor hook on every delivery
